key.description: Env key to copy for kind "env".

defaultDomainBase.description: Base of generated service domains, or null when default domains are unavailable.

domain.description: Custom public hostname; null uses the generated default domain.

postUrl.description: POST the form here (carries the signed state in its query).

manifest.description: JSON string to submit as the `manifest` form field.

installUrl.description: Send the admin here to install the App on their repositories.

grant.description: Signed grant from the install callback redirect (git_grant query param).

installUrl.description: Where a team owner installs the App on their repositories.

callbackUrl.description: Paste this as the OAuth redirect URI on the Gitea application.

webhookUrl.description: Optional repo webhook URL for instant auto-deploy.

authorizeUrl.description: Where a team owner authorizes kubwave against Gitea.

model.description: Model id with an optional ":effort" suffix, e.g. claude-opus-5:high.
